target: ManiPose rigid-skeleton constraint transfer to current COCO17 surface operator
inputs: actual licensed SMPLH male/MANO config assets and existing J_regressor_coco.npy; two artificial poses, same beta0/T[0,0,3]; no network
only_variable: identity rotations versus elbows z +/-70deg, knees x60/45deg; all other state components fixed
controls: 52 internal FK joint distances to registered parents versus declared COCO17 surface limb edges on the same meshes
coverage: all51 internal edges and all8 declared COCO limb edges, no failure filtering
reason: if identical beta with rigid internal bones permits surface-length changes, constant COCO limb loss would impose a different operator contract
analytic_addendum: two2-edge populations: one ambiguous edge/one fixed edge versus both ambiguous; check mean-edge squared length = expected squared length - trace covariance; nondegenerate full pose does not force every edge to shrink
stop: one bounded two-state decode; preserve mismatch/nonfinite/failure; do not replace generator or train a skeleton head
boundary: operator consistency and exact identity only; no real anatomy, accuracy or learned model benefit claim
source: paper2312.06386v2 methods3.1/3.2, theory4.1/B.1, Table4, AppendixD; official manifold decoder/FK/rotation/aggregation/config read
